label: Late runs — the full inventory, read aloud
location: The hub vault, the stash counter

recentEvents.value: She reads the complete vault inventory to him now, every deposit: bowls, toys, fishing hooks, family portraits, a winter's seed grain — filed, as always, exactly as received.
He asked whether the vault was secure. It is. That is the problem she no longer softens.

unresolvedConflicts.value: Her rule — never mislabel an item — is now the sharpest blade in the hub: the ledger says 'bowl', he hears 'instrument of evil', and the ledger does not change.

temporaryObjective.value: Read the ledger aloud, item by item, and never once mislabel a thing.

notes: The escalation endpoint: the full-inventory-read-aloud. The ledger is the hub's quiet indictment; the never-mislabel rule survives both states (profile notes).
